description: This Java source file defines the AttributesModified event class within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things package. It represents an immutable event emitted after all attributes of a Thing were modified at once. The class includes methods for constructing instances from parameters or JSON, retrieving modified attributes, and serializing the event to JSON. It also overrides equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

classes.name: AttributesModified
classes.description: An immutable event class representing the modification of all attributes on a Thing at once. It provides methods to create instances from parameters or JSON, access modified attributes, and serialize the event object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory methods for creating AttributesModified instances with various parameter combinations, including deprecated variants and one that accepts metadata.

methods.description: Creates an AttributesModified instance from a JSON string or JSON object, using the EventJsonDeserializer.

methods.name: getModifiedAttributes
methods.description: Returns the Attributes instance representing the modifications.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns a JsonPointer to the resource path ('/attributes') associated with this event.

methods.description: Returns a new AttributesModified with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new AttributesModified with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Serializes attributes modifications into a JsonObjectBuilder, respecting schema and predicate filters.
